name: Baked Scallops with Endive

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 230°C (450°F). Line two small gratin dishes or one medium casserole dish with endive leaves. Dot with butter. Place the gratin dishes on a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes. Top with scallops, season with salt and pepper, and turn the scallops in the butter now melted in the bottom of each dish. Return to oven and continue baking until scallops are cooked through, about 8 minutes longer. Serve immediately with lemon wedges and bread for soaking up melted butter.

schema_metadata.keywords: endive, French in a Flash, quick, scallops, seafood, shellfish

description: This simple baked scallop and endive dinner takes four ingredients (plus salt, pepper, and a lemon to serve it with) with no extra dishes to clean.
notes: Optional or for serving: Lemon wedges, for serving; Hearty bread, for serving
author: Kerry Saretsky
